title: GTA6 Pre-Orders Heavily Skewed Towards PS5 According to Reports
description: Reports indicate that GTA 6 pre-orders are heavily skewed towards the PS5 as Sony dominates the generation's biggest game release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Pre-Orders Show Heavy Skew Towards PS5

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6, new industry reports are shedding light on how the game's launch is shaping up across different consoles. According to a recent report from Push Square, GTA 6 pre-orders are reportedly "heavily skewed" towards the PlayStation 5, suggesting that Sony is dominating what is shaping up to be the biggest game of the generation.

## The Impact of Sony's Marketing Strategy

Industry insights indicate that Sony is spending a significant amount of money to ensure that GTA 6 "feels" like an exclusive title on its platform. Based on current market observations, this strategy is reportedly working well, helping Sony secure a dominant position in the early momentum of the industry's most anticipated title.

## Context Behind Xbox's Current Position

This news arrives amidst a backdrop of broader turbulence at Xbox. A report by The Verge recently highlighted ongoing dramas within Microsoft's gaming division, including massive layoffs and major structural reorganizations. These internal shifts have led to ongoing discussions about the platform's current identity and market standing, particularly as it navigates a challenging competitive landscape alongside major publisher integration.

## Editor's Take

The strong skew in pre-orders towards the PS5 highlights the power of strategic marketing and platform momentum. While GTA 6 will undoubtedly be a massive hit across platforms, Sony's aggressive push ensures they remain at the forefront of this generation's biggest release.
